name: toolbar
title: Toolbar
description: A row of quiet controls with one tab stop and arrow-key movement (role="toolbar"), with groups, separators, links and a compact field.
usage: Use Toolbar for a set of related commands above a surface: a query tab's Run, Cancel, Format and row limit; an editor's formatting row. Compose Toolbar > ToolbarGroup (ToolbarButton …), ToolbarSeparator, ToolbarLink, ToolbarInput. Give it an aria-label and icon-only buttons an aria-label. Put another control in the focus order with render (render={<ToggleButton />}); keep disabled buttons focusable with focusableWhenDisabled. For the app's bottom status line use StatusBar; for a menu bar of menus use Menubar.

props.name: variant
props.description: bar: a surface with a bottom border; plain: no frame.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Direction of the items and of the arrow keys that move between them.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Arrow keys wrap from the last item to the first.

props.name: children
props.description: Groups, buttons, separators, links and inputs.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: role="toolbar"; data-slot="toolbar", data-variant, data-orientation. Scrolls sideways when too wide.

slots.name: button
slots.description: A ghost button of size.control.sm; data-slot="toolbar-button", data-pressed, data-disabled.

slots.name: separator
slots.description: A rule perpendicular to the toolbar; data-slot="toolbar-separator".

parts.name: ToolbarGroup
parts.description: Items that belong together; disabled disables them all.

parts.name: ToolbarButton
parts.description: A quiet button in the focus order; render swaps the control.

parts.name: ToolbarLink
parts.description: A link in the focus order.

parts.name: ToolbarInput
parts.description: A compact text field; arrow keys at its ends leave it.

states.name: vertical
states.description: Items stacked; Up and Down move between them.

states.name: pressed
states.description: A toggle rendered as a ToolbarButton, on: color.interactive.selected.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus: an inset ring of ring.width in color.ring.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Dimmed to opacity.disabled; still focusable with focusableWhenDisabled.

accessibility: role="toolbar" with aria-orientation; the whole toolbar is one tab stop and the arrow keys move between items, wrapping at the ends with loopFocus (Base UI's roving focus; it has no Home/End).
Name the toolbar with aria-label and each icon-only button with aria-label.
Disabled buttons can stay focusable (focusableWhenDisabled) with aria-disabled, so arrow-key users still find them.
ToolbarInput keeps the arrow keys while the caret is inside the text and leaves at its ends.
Focus rings are inset so the toolbar's sideways scroll does not clip them.
